G53-V12 live provider still disabled; no module in src / validation opens a network path; run records never carry an endpoint

validation_evaluator.name: EV-1 replay of an unperturbed stored record → every evaluated key is correct; deterministic across two runs; no forbidden key
EV-2 MISSING: a dropped colour key on the footwear → MISSING + critical miss (SVP-005 CRITICAL_DIRECTION) with the downstream evidence note left to the register
EV-3 WRONG_VALUE: final upper relation Regular instead of Relaxed → WRONG_VALUE with expected / observed recorded
EV-4 HALLUCINATION: an extra exposure region, a fact not in the reference, a value where the reference says ABSENT, and an admitted non-participant
EV-5 STATE_ERROR subtypes: UNKNOWN when readable · OBSERVED when unreadable · ABSENT when NOT_VISIBLE · NOT_VISIBLE when visible

EV-7 OWNERSHIP_DEDUP_ERROR: a duplicated colour phenomenon, and a brooch kept both as a jacket attachment and a jewellery component

EV-9 reports: parameter-level raw counts (+ rates per applicable), image-level counts, critical-miss register; identity mismatch refused; missing run identity flagged

v13_transport.name: TR-1 sealed raw responses are read as stored (text sha256 = seal) and parse to exactly one JSON object each; thinking / usage are never read as evidence
TR-2 strict parser rejects empty · prose · arrays · truncated JSON · trailing content · incomplete (max_tokens) responses — fail transparently, never repaired
TR-3 four different emitted shapes (objects array/object · facts map/array · colour flat/nested · frame wrapped) all convert to ONE canonical case and produce a VALID packet
TR-4 the converter changes structure only: every transformation is logged with its raw input; no transformation kind invents a value (allowed kinds enumerated)

TR-5 value fidelity: every OBSERVED fact value in the canonical case equals the model's emitted value (after representation normalisation); UNKNOWN stays UNKNOWN; ABSENT stays ABSENT; nothing appears that the model did not emit

TR-6 missing ≠ ABSENT: a participant without any colour entry becomes colour UNKNOWN (logged NOT_EMITTED); an applicable fact the model omitted is listed as not_emitted and reaches the pool as UNKNOWN — never ABSENT
TR-7 nothing is invented: OBSERVED without value · null value · value outside the governed domain · unknown fact name · state outside domain → UNCONVERTIBLE (raw kept) and the fact is NOT emitted

TR-8 representation only: a one-element array on a single-value fact becomes the scalar; a MULTI fact keeps the emitted representation (scalar or array — CDM-18 pending, the converter takes no side); two values on a single-value fact are UNCONVERTIBLE
TR-9 forbidden content is refused at transport: a score / direction / verdict / product_context key anywhere in the response throws

TR-10 colour parts: a free-text part is kept in the log and never mapped unless it IS a Colour V1 / Item token verbatim; partial colour (family known, lightness UNKNOWN) → partial carrier, no invented lightness

TR-11 F390 live output: non-realized exposure rows have no slot and are kept in the log; the realized Upper Thigh record (∅ carrier, attribution UNKNOWN) survives conversion exactly; "Waistband" securing regions are carried verbatim (CDM-04 B), not quarantined

TR-12 F298 live output is converted faithfully — it still carries the model's own reading (belt as a separate component, device_is_own false, coat olive, shoulder Extreme): the converter never corrects toward reference v1_3 / CEO_GT

TR-13 DM: no live output carries a DM block → dm_acquisition NOT_ACQUIRED / PROMPT_V1_2_HAS_NO_DM_SECTION; a DM block in a model output is passed verbatim to the frozen adapter (fixture F444 block as the stand-in) and an illegal block is rejected by the adapter, never repaired

v13_states_relations.name: ST-1 OBSERVED · ABSENT · UNKNOWN · NOT_VISIBLE(+limitation) are four distinct pool states; a stored reading of "None" is OBSERVED/None (not ABSENT); NOT_APPLICABLE is never stored; a missing reading is UNKNOWN

ST-2 hidden-by-participant stays a token (NOT_VISIBLE + OCCLUDED_BY_OTHER_GARMENT); Vision never converts it into ABSENT, UNKNOWN or a negative finding (IX-1(b) is a scorer rule); a cropped region carries its own limitation

ST-3 own device (CDM-03 S1): F134 / M309 own belt → one own-device securing entry on the garment itself (securing_ref = affected_ref, device_is_own true), waist_definition Cinched stays an independent observation, no belt component, one physical cause once

ST-4 F298 negative controls: (a) the V1.2 stored reading (belt as a separate component c4 → coat) is still representable and stays a cross-component relation; (b) the CDM-03 S1 reading (own belt, no c4) yields the own-device entry; (c) BOTH at once on the same region is refused (R2_SAME_CAUSE_COUNTED_TWICE); (d) an own device naming another component is refused

ST-5 affected component ≠ affected region (CDM-04 B): the region token is carried verbatim (no enum forced, no substitution); the validator accepts a token outside the 5-region reference convention; a magnitude key is still refused

ST-6 layer relations (CDM-05 B): directly visible garment-over-garment only; an accessory pair is never admitted (kept as excluded provenance); UNKNOWN-identity participants are admitted; no transitive pair is derived; duplicate / contradictory pairs are refused

ST-7 partial colour: family known + lightness UNKNOWN → partial carrier (no lightness invented); a partial point keeps its contrast; a partial entry satisfies colour completeness; an impossible partial (lightness both unresolved and given) is refused by the validator

ST-8 functional hardware attribution: a metallic buckle / clasp colour is a point on the carrying accessory (never a garment colour, never a component); a metal part on a garment carries carrier_part = Item token; nothing in the packet names it decorative or an EI point

ST-9 G-6 four-value observation domain preserved (Structured · Semi-Structured · Semi-Fluid · Fluid); "Balanced" refused; the middle ambiguity fails closed to UNKNOWN; no Item GT is forced into the Full-Look observation (F298 shoulder stays the look reading)

ST-10 no new Vision parameter: the requestable set is still the 26 Item facts; split sleeve / lower-zip opening / scarf wrapping have no field (descriptor channels only); product_context stays metadata

v13_dm_tc.name: TC-E1 every participating garment gets a product-evidence view entry: archetype key by the frozen map, the predicate-read facts with their states, completeness counts, evidence classes; accessories are excluded (TC-D-4b HELD); UNKNOWN identity → no key
TC-E2 the view is NOT in the packet, NOT a parameter and carries no look-level T / C, no styling, no score (packet validation and run record untouched; view scanned for forbidden words)

TC-E4 not every oversized-looking garment is a frozen departure: fit Relaxed → SIL-FALSE-LADDER; fit NOT_VISIBLE → SIL-STATE (UNRESOLVED, never Classic); the look-level final_upper_relation is NOT an input to the predicate

TC-E5 product-evidence completeness is reported per fact (OBSERVED / ABSENT / NOT_VISIBLE / UNKNOWN / NOT_EMITTED / NOT_APPLICABLE) with route / source provenance; an EI-only run leaves TC facts NOT_EMITTED (demand-driven pool), a full run has none
DM-1 frozen DM authority pinned by sha256 (49e513ea…) and verified at every adaptation; a hash mismatch fails closed; the adapter never changes the block (fingerprint = block)

DM-2 the 14 fixture DM blocks all pass admission (A–J families, relational form H only, three primitives in the frozen domains, repeated_units); RC4 (Transport V2): all 14 delivered — 1 with DMP-3 OBSERVED (M323, a recorded limit) + 13 with DMP-3 UNKNOWN (12 no-limit · M178 occlusion alone), systems verbatim; the 21 looks without a block carry NOT_ACQUIRED / FIXTURE_HAS_NO_DM_BLOCK
